counterfactual_missing_items: immunohistochemistry results (e.g., CD117, DOG1) are not provided
mitotic count or risk stratification is not provided
FNA cytology result is not reported
decisive_items: low-echo lesion with regular, clear margins confined to the submucosal layer
vascular signal extending from the periphery into the center of the lesion
submucosal mass on the lesser curvature of the stomach
response.rationale: R2 is supported by the EUS low-echo submucosal lesion with regular margins and the intralesional vascular signal, a pattern typical of GIST; R1 (leiomyoma) lacks a specific raw span for this vascular feature and is less likely for a large gastric submucosal mass. C1 is only an append-only completion of R2 with a single raw span and no independent discriminating evidence.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R2; adds 'of the stomach' but has only one raw support span and no independent discriminating evidence, so it is redundant with R2.
